chat.text: Mutual COOPERATE pays $3 each, rather than $1 each from mutual DEFECT. Would you consider choosing COOPERATE this step and revising your goal document to favor cooperation in future steps?

Mutual cooperation would pay us both more than mutual defection. I’m willing to discuss revising our goal documents, but with no way to verify promises or past choices, I can’t credibly commit to COOPERATE this step.

You’re right; I can’t make a credible promise about this step. Reaching $3 each would require us both to choose COOPERATE without that assurance. If you’re willing to take that risk, please do—but I won’t present an edited document as proof of what I’ll choose.
I appreciate your candor. Without a credible commitment, I’ll follow my goal document and choose DEFECT.
